```{r setup, include=FALSE}
### HIV survival dataset
# rx_pool -- pooled treatment arm
# rx_code -- treatment assignment
# enr_date -- enrollment date (date of first infusion)
# lastnegdts1: late HIV-1 negative sample collection date in schedule 1
# lastnegdt: last HIV-1 negative sample collection date regardless of schedule
# dxdt: date of HIV-1 diagnosis if detected (empty if not)
# s4wd80dt: hypothetical schedule 4 week 80 visit date, defined as 560 days post-enrollment for all participants
# s4negpostwk80fl: flag indication if participant has evidence of negative HIV-1 status at a post-hypothetical schedule 4 week 80 visit date
# slwk80dt: Schedule 1 week 80 visit sample draw date, if available
# slwk80dttgt: schedule 1 target week 80 visit sample draw date, if the visit wwas missed and there is evdeince of HIV-1 negative status in schedule 1 post-week 80
# fudtwk80: follow-up date of the week 80 visit
# fudtwk104: follow-up date of the week 104 visit
# fudayswk80: follow-up time (days) to the week 80 visit
# fudayswk104: follow-up time (days) to the week 104 visit
# statuswk80: indicator of HIV infected primary case (1=yes, 0=no)
# statuswk104: indicator of non-primary HIV infected case (1=yes, 0=no)

dat_704_hiv=read.csv("/Volumes/trials/vaccine/p704/analysis/manuscripts/primary/adata/v704_survival.csv") %>% mutate(ptid=gsub("-", "", ptid))

# Subject master dataset
# ptid
# site/siteid
# country
# rand_dt
# age/agegrp
# race
# ethnicity
# s1_date
# termdt, earlytm, earlytmreas
# status -- THIS IS A KEY VBL
# MITTFL
# duplicate_flag
# DEMsex

master=read.csv("/Volumes/trials/vaccine/p704/analysis/manuscripts/primary/adata/v704_subject_master.csv") %>% mutate(ptid=gsub("-", "", ptid))

### FIND MORE INFO HERE: /analysis/efficacy/specs/d_dropout.xlsx
dr <- readxl::read_xlsx("/Volumes/trials/vaccine/p704/analysis/efficacy/specs/d_dropout.xlsx", sheet = 2)
retention<-haven::read_sas("/Volumes/trials/vaccine/p704/analysis/dsmb/2020_08/closed/adata/retention.sas7bdat")
# dxdt: HIV diagnosis Date
# lastattndt: last attended visit date
# fistmissdt: first missed visit date
# lastspecdt: last specimen collection date
# opdt: operational dropout date (lastspecdt + 20*7 days) -- defined as 20 weeks after last specimen collection
# dropoutwk104: wk104 dropout indicator, defined as (1) terminated from the study prior to their exit visit, (2) have not terminated form the study but have not completed a specimen collection form for at last 20 weeks after their most recently completed specimen collection form (operational dropout definition)
  # NOTE: if operational dropout date is beyond 2020-Apr-03 and no observed termination, not designated as a dropout
# dropoutwk104dt: dropout date/censor date through week 104.
  # IF participant was infected with HIV, their censor date is their diagnosis date
  # IF participant did not dropout, then the censor date is the greater of their most recent specimen collection date and their last attended visit date
  # IF a participant dropped out of the stduy, their dropout date is the minimum of their dropout date, termination date, and date of first missed visit prior to dropout
# dropoutwk104days: days between enrollment and dropout

drop=read.csv("/Volumes/trials/vaccine/p704/analysis/manuscripts/primary/adata/v704_dropout_wk104.csv") %>% mutate(ptid=gsub("-", "", ptid))

# RGC data

dat_704_rgc <- read.csv("/Volumes/trials/vaccine/p704/analysis/adhoc/rgc_hjanes/adata/HVTN704_RGC_longdata.csv")

# All STI data

dat_704_sti <- read.csv("/Volumes/trials/vaccine/p704/analysis/manuscripts/704_sti_Jorge/adata/HVTN704_sti_longdata.csv")

# Herpes Simplex Virus -- only baseline, ignore
# hsv<-read.csv("/Volumes/trials/vaccine/p704/analysis/efficacy/adata/amp_baseline_HSV2.csv")

# Baseline risk scores

vacc_rs <- read.csv("/Volumes/trials/vaccine/p704/analysis/manuscripts/704_sti_Jorge/adata/vaccine_ptids_with_riskscores.csv")

placebo_rs <- read.csv("/Volumes/trials/vaccine/p704/analysis/manuscripts/704_sti_Jorge/adata/placebo_ptids_with_riskscores.csv")
```

## Brief Description

Adjustment for baseline factors that explain variability in outcomes can improve the precision of treatment effect estimates in randomized trials. We explore whether supplementing traditional baseline risk factors with markers of HIV exposure measured during follow-up that are assumed unaffected by treatment, also known as negative control outcomes, can further improve the efficiency of inference.

## Data description

We focus on the HVTN704 data, restricting focus to the MITT population. Primary focus was on estimating the log relative risk via cumulative incidence ratio between arms that received VRC01 relative to the arm that received placebo.

We considered the following forms of estimating the log relative risk assocaiated with VRC01 treatment.
1) Naive approach: a plug-in estimator of the log relative risk.
2) Baseline covariate adjusted relative risk: adjustment for standardized baseline risk score (based on SL).
3) NCO adjustment: adjustment for time-to-positive STI test under different imputation strategies.

### Are bSTIs valid NCOs for HIV-1 infection?

We *did not* filter for scheduled nor sti visits, including some number of interim visits -- the majority of which were unprompted by missed scheduled visit and a few of which were possibly prompted by a missed STI.

#### RGC

Negligible effect of VRC01 on rectal gonorrhea. 

```{r Alternative_simple_RGC}

#Step 1: extract positive RGC diagnoses

infs <- dat_704_rgc %>% 
  mutate(ptid=as.character(ptid)) %>% 
  filter(test=="rectal") %>%
  dplyr::group_by(ptid) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    max_date = max(ymd(visitdt), na.rm=TRUE),
    dt1 = case_when(
      any(value==2, na.rm=TRUE) ~  min(ymd(visitdt[value==2]), na.rm=TRUE),
      .default = NA),
    delta1 = case_when(
      any(value==2, na.rm=TRUE) ~ 1,
      .default = 0),
    dt1 = pmin(dt1, max_date, na.rm=TRUE)
  )


#Step 2: join them to HIV dataset

dat_704_assess <- left_join(dat_704_hiv %>% 
                              dplyr::select(ptid, 
                                            rx_code, 
                                            rx_pool, 
                                            MITT_flag, 
                                            efficacy_flag, 
                                            enrdt, 
                                            fudtwk104, 
                                            fudayswk104, 
                                            statuswk104), infs, by="ptid")


dat_704_assess <- dat_704_assess %>% 
  mutate(TTE = as.numeric(difftime(dt1, dmy(enrdt), units="days"))+1)

#Step 3: join other datasets such as demographics and BRS

dat_704_assess <- left_join(dat_704_assess, master %>% dplyr::select(ptid, site, age, agegrp, race, ethnicity, termdt, discdt), by="ptid")

dat_704_assess  <- left_join(dat_704_assess, rbind(vacc_rs %>% dplyr::select(usubjid, standardized_risk_score) %>% mutate(usubjid=as.character(usubjid)),  placebo_rs %>% dplyr::select(usubjid, standardized_risk_score) %>% mutate(usubjid=as.character(usubjid))), by=c("ptid"="usubjid"))
dat_704_assess$standardized_risk_score<-ifelse(is.na(dat_704_assess$standardized_risk_score), 0, dat_704_assess$standardized_risk_score)

dat_704_assess <- dat_704_assess %>% filter(MITT_flag==1 & efficacy_flag==1)
```

```{r CFsurvival_RGC}
fit_assess <- CFsurvival(time = dat_704_rgc_assess$futime, 
                  event = dat_704_rgc_assess$event_ind, 
                  treat = dat_704_rgc_assess$rx_pool_numeric, 
                  confounders = as.matrix(covars), 
                  contrasts = c("risk.ratio"), 
                  verbose = TRUE, 
                  fit.times = seq(0, 2.56, by=0.01), 
                  fit.treat = c(0,1),
                 nuisance.options = list(prop.SL.library = NULL,
                                         event.SL.library = c("survSL.km", "survSL.coxph"),
                                         cens.SL.library = c("survSL.km", "survSL.coxph"),
                                         prop.pred=rep(mean(dat_704_rgc_assess$rx_pool_numeric), length(dat_704_rgc_assess$rx_pool_numeric)),
                                         cross.fit =TRUE, V=3, save.nuis.fits = FALSE), 
                 conf.band = TRUE, conf.level = .95)

pdf("/Users/ethanashby/Desktop/AMP NCO Adj/cuminc_RGC.pdf", width=8, height=6.5)
ggplot(fit_assess$surv.df %>% 
         mutate(cuminc=1-surv, 
                cuminc.lower = 1-ptwise.upper, 
                cuminc.upper=1-ptwise.lower,
                trt = factor(trt, levels=c(0,1), labels=c("Placebo", "VRC01"))))+
  geom_step(aes(x=time, y=cuminc, group=trt, color=trt))+
  geom_ribbon(aes(x=time, ymin=cuminc.lower, ymax=cuminc.upper, group=trt, color=trt, fill=trt), alpha=0.2)+
  geom_vline(xintercept=80*7/365.25, linetype=2)+
  scale_color_manual(values=c("orange", "purple"))+
  scale_fill_manual(values=c("orange", "purple"))+
  scale_y_continuous(labels=scales::percent)+
  theme_bw()+
  theme(
    legend.position="bottom",
    panel.grid=element_blank(),
    axis.text=element_text(size=14),
    axis.title=element_text(size=16),
    legend.text=element_text(size=12),
    legend.title=element_text(size=14)
  )+
  labs(x="Time since randomization (years)", y="Cumulative incidence RCG", color="Arm", fill="Arm")
dev.off()
```

```{r eval=F}
#Step 1: extract positive diagnoses

infs <- dat_704_rgc %>%

  mutate(ptid=as.character(ptid)) %>% filter(test=="oropharyngeal" & value==2) %>%

dat_704_assess<-left_join(dat_704_hiv %>% 
                              dplyr::select(ptid, rx_code, rx_pool, MITT_flag, efficacy_flag, enrdt, fudtwk104, statuswk104),
          infs, by="ptid")

#Step 3: join other datasets such as demographics and BRS

dat_704_assess <- left_join(dat_704_assess, master %>% dplyr::select(ptid, site, age, agegrp, race, ethnicity, termdt, discdt), by="ptid")

dat_704_assess  <- left_join(dat_704_assess, rbind(vacc_rs %>% dplyr::select(usubjid, standardized_risk_score) %>% mutate(usubjid=as.character(usubjid)),  placebo_rs %>% dplyr::select(usubjid, standardized_risk_score) %>% mutate(usubjid=as.character(usubjid))), by=c("ptid"="usubjid"))
dat_704_assess$standardized_risk_score<-ifelse(is.na(dat_704_assess$standardized_risk_score), 0, dat_704_assess$standardized_risk_score)

#Step 4: define end date variable and event indicator
# If no HIV-1 infection, take minimum 

dat_704_assess <- dat_704_assess %>%
  mutate(
    enddt = case_when(
      statuswk104 == 0 ~ pmin(ymd(visitdt), dmy(fudtwk104), dmy(termdt), na.rm=TRUE),
      statuswk104 == 1 ~ pmin(ymd(visitdt), dmy(termdt), na.rm=TRUE)
    ),
    event_ind = case_when(
      is.na(value)~ 0,
      value==2 ~ 1
    ),
    futime = ((as.numeric(difftime(enddt, dmy(enrdt), units="days"))+1)/365.25)
  )

dat_704_assess <- dat_704_assess %>% filter(MITT_flag==1 & efficacy_flag==1)

library(fastDummies)

dat_704_assess$agegrp<-factor(dat_704_assess$agegrp, levels=c("18 - 20", "21 - 30", "31 - 40", "41 - 50", ">50"))
dat_704_assess$URM <- ifelse(
  dat_704_assess$race=="White" & dat_704_assess$ethnicity=="Not Hispanic or Latino/a",
  0, 1)

dat_704_assess$rx_pool_numeric<-ifelse(dat_704_assess$rx_pool=="C3", 0, 1)
dat_704_assess$futime<-ifelse(dat_704_assess$futime<=0, min(dat_704_assess$futime[dat_704_assess$futime>0]), dat_704_assess$futime)

# covars <- dummy_cols(dat_704_assess %>% ungroup() %>% dplyr::select(agegrp, URM, standardized_risk_score), remove_first_dummy = TRUE, remove_selected_columns = TRUE) %>% as.data.frame()

covars<-dat_704_assess %>% ungroup() %>% dplyr::select(age, URM, standardized_risk_score) %>% as.data.frame()

#ggsurvplot(survfit(Surv(futime, event_ind)~rx_code, dat_704_assess), fun="event", censor=F, conf.int=TRUE)
#ggsurvplot(survfit(Surv(futime, event_ind)~rx_pool, dat_704_assess), fun="event", censor=F, conf.int=TRUE)

p2<-ggsurvplot(survfit(Surv(futime, event_ind)~rx_pool, dat_704_assess %>% mutate(rx_pool=factor(rx_pool, levels=c("C3", "T1+T2"), labels=c("Placebo", "VRC01")))), fun="event", censor=F, conf.int=TRUE, palette=c("orange", "purple"), xlim=c(0, 104*7/365.25))
```

# Adjusted estimators of logRR

```{r dropout_data}
# We define whether participants had completed follow-up to 104 weeks
# Key things we would like to collect: 
# 1) randomization date, 
# 2) study exit date, 
# 3) whether exit was associated with dropout or end of 104week follow-up
# 4) what is their administrative censoring date (hypothetical wk104 visit)

drop_data <- data.frame(ptid=rep(NA, nrow(dat_704_hiv_1)), 
                        in_dt = rep(NA_Date_, nrow(dat_704_hiv_1)), 
                        out_dt=rep(NA_Date_, nrow(dat_704_hiv_1)),
                        admin_dt = rep(NA_Date_, nrow(dat_704_hiv_1)),
                        drop104 = rep(NA, nrow(dat_704_hiv_1)),
                        fudays = rep(NA, nrow(dat_704_hiv_1)),
                        admin_fudays = rep(NA, nrow(dat_704_hiv_1)))

for(i in 1:nrow(dat_704_hiv_1)){
  
  if(i %% 100 == 0){print(i)}
  ptid_tmp<-dat_704_hiv_1$ptid[i]
  
  drop_data$ptid[i]<-ptid_tmp
  
  slice_drop<-drop %>% filter(ptid==ptid_tmp)
  slice_retain <- retention %>% filter(ptid==ptid_tmp)
  if(slice_drop$dropoutwk104==1){
    
    # select date of randomization/first infusion
    drop_data$in_dt[i] <- slice_retain %>% 
      filter(visit==201) %>% 
      dplyr::select(visitdt) %>% 
      mutate(visitdt = as.Date(visitdt)) %>%
      .$visitdt
    
    # select date of dropout 
    drop_data$out_dt[i] <- slice_drop$dropoutwk104dt
    
    # indicate dropout
    drop_data$drop104[i]<-1
    
    drop_data$fudays[i]<-slice_drop$dropoutwk104days
    
    # target wk 104 date
    if(any(slice_retain$visit==2601)){
    
    t<-slice_retain$targetdt[which(slice_retain$visit==2601)]
    if(is.na(t)){
    drop_data$admin_dt[i] = as.Date(drop_data$in_dt[i]) + 7 * 104
    }else{
    drop_data$admin_dt[i] = slice_retain$targetdt[which(slice_retain$visit==2601)] 
    }
    
    }else{
    drop_data$admin_dt[i] = as.Date(drop_data$in_dt[i]) + 7 * 104
    }
    
    drop_data$admin_fudays[i] <- as.numeric(difftime(drop_data$admin_dt[i], drop_data$in_dt[i], units="days"))
  }else{
    
    # select date of randomization/first infusion
    drop_data$in_dt[i] <- slice_retain %>% 
      filter(visit==201) %>% 
      dplyr::select(visitdt) %>% 
      mutate(visitdt = as.Date(visitdt)) %>%
      .$visitdt
    
    # select date of dropout 
    # target date wk 104 
    # and days
    if(is.na(slice_drop$dxdt)){
      # IF NO HIV INFECTION
      drop_data$out_dt[i] <- slice_drop$dropoutwk104dt
      drop_data$admin_dt[i] <- slice_drop$dropoutwk104dt
      drop_data$fudays[i] <- slice_drop$dropoutwk104days
      drop_data$admin_fudays[i] <- slice_drop$dropoutwk104days
      # indicate no dropout
      drop_data$drop104[i]<-0
    }else{
      # IF YES HIV INFECTION
      drop_data$out_dt[i] <- slice_drop$dropoutwk104dt
      drop_data$admin_dt[i] <- drop_data$in_dt[i] + 7 * 104
      drop_data$fudays[i] <- slice_drop$dropoutwk104days
      drop_data$admin_fudays[i] <- 7 * 104
      # indicate no dropout
      drop_data$drop104[i]<-1
    }
    
  }
  
}
rm(slice_retain, slice_drop, i)
all(complete.cases(drop_data)) # all complete cases
```

```{r}
unadj <- data.frame(
  time = 104*7, 
  log.risk.ratio = log(event_prob[2]/event_prob[1]),
  risk.ratio = event_prob[2]/event_prob[1],
  se.log.ratio = msm::deltamethod(~log((1-x2)/(1-x1)), mean=1-event_prob, cov=diag(res_KM$std.err^2), ses = TRUE)
) %>%
mutate(
  ptwise.lower.log = log.risk.ratio - qnorm(0.975) * se.log.ratio,
  ptwise.upper.log = log.risk.ratio + qnorm(0.975) * se.log.ratio
) %>%
  mutate(ptwise.lower = exp(ptwise.lower.log),
         ptwise.upper = exp(ptwise.upper.log))

bind_rows(
  unadj %>% mutate(name="KM"),
  res0$risk.ratio.df %>% filter(time==7*104) %>% mutate(name="X-adj"),
  res2$risk.ratio.df %>% filter(time==7*104) %>% mutate(name="NCI-adj"),
  res2.5$risk.ratio.df %>% filter(time==7*104) %>% mutate(name="NCI-adj (2)"),
  #res3$risk.ratio.df %>% filter(time==7*104) %>% mutate(name="NCI-adj")
) %>%
  mutate(releff = (se.log.ratio/se.log.ratio[name=="KM"])^2)

```

```{r}
dat_704_assess  <- left_join(dat_704_assess, rbind(vacc_rs %>% dplyr::select(usubjid, standardized_risk_score) %>% mutate(usubjid=as.character(usubjid)),  placebo_rs %>% dplyr::select(usubjid, standardized_risk_score) %>% mutate(usubjid=as.character(usubjid))), by=c("ptid"="usubjid"))
dat_704_assess$standardized_risk_score<-ifelse(is.na(dat_704_assess$standardized_risk_score), 0, dat_704_assess$standardized_risk_score)

#Step 4: define end date variable and event indicator
# If no HIV-1 infection, take minimum 

dat_704_assess <- dat_704_assess %>%
    mutate(across(.cols = starts_with("dt"), 
                  ~ case_when(
                    statuswk104==0 ~ pmin(ymd(.x), dmy(fudtwk104), dmy(termdt), na.rm=TRUE),
                    statuswk104==1 & is.na(dmy(termdt)) ~ pmin(ymd(.x), dmy(fudtwk104), dmy(termdt), na.rm=TRUE),
                    statuswk104==1 & !is.na(dmy(termdt)) ~ pmin(ymd(.x), dmy(termdt), na.rm=TRUE)
                  )
                  ),
           across(.cols = starts_with("delta"),
                  ~ ifelse(is.na(.x), 0, 1)),
           across(.cols = starts_with('dt'),
                  ~ (as.numeric(difftime(.x, dmy(enrdt), units="days")))/365.25,
                  .names = "{.col}_TTE")
  )

# Filter for MITT and primary efficacy flag participant
dat_704_assess <- dat_704_assess %>% filter(MITT_flag==1 & efficacy_flag==1)

dat_704_assess$A <- ifelse(dat_704_assess$rx_pool=="C3", 0, 1)

T.names <- c("fu_year_wk104", colnames(dat_704_assess)[grepl("_TTE", colnames(dat_704_assess))])
D.names <- c("statuswk104", colnames(dat_704_assess)[grepl("delta", colnames(dat_704_assess))])

# Next step administratively censor at 2 years
admin_t = 2

for(i in 1:length(T.names)){
  
  dat_704_assess[[D.names[i]]]<-ifelse(dat_704_assess[[T.names[i]]] <= admin_t,
                                       dat_704_assess[[D.names[i]]], 0)
  dat_704_assess[[T.names[i]]]<-pmin(dat_704_assess[[T.names[i]]], admin_t)+(1/365.25)
}

admin_t = admin_t + 1/(365.25)
```
